description: Custom correction-bias lookup is not propagated to tensor export.
trigger: Load a present bias using a nondefault key_e_score_bias, then call BlockSparseMLP.get_tensors.
expected_behavior: Export the bias under the configured tensor name.
actual_behavior: load requests the configured suffix, but get_tensors emits gate.e_score_correction_bias. No built-in construction site supplies a custom suffix, so established reach is the new API rather than an existing model workflow.

finding.description: Ernie exercises the inherited disagreement between custom correction-bias lookup and export naming.
finding.trigger: Load a present moe_statics.e_score_correction_bias and export the sparse module through get_tensors, including conversion's tensor collection.
finding.expected_behavior: Preserve the configured correction-bias tensor name for reload.
finding.actual_behavior: load requests <mlp>.moe_statics.e_score_correction_bias, but get_tensors emits <mlp>.gate.e_score_correction_bias. Conversion collects those tensors and reloads modules from the resulting dictionary. Ernie's optional custom lookup then loses the tensor; its current standard routing ignores the bias, so a routing-output change is not established.
